MISSING_DOCUMENT.explanation: December 2024 has an active ExpectedDocRule for monthly diesel slips, but no document exists.

DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED.explanation: Both documents share identical SHA-256 hash and bill slip number DS-2024-1001.

IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.explanation: Fuel quantity 520,000 litres is >10x historical median, exceeding 3x IQR.

ESTIMATED_SHARE_HIGH.explanation: Electricity activity record a034 is estimated (74,400 kg CO2e), accounting for 72.6% of December emissions (> 10% threshold).

SPIKE_MOM.explanation: August diesel consumption of 18,500 L is 3.25x the trailing 3-month median of 5,700 L, triggering Red severity.

HOTSPOT_DETECTED.explanation: Grid electricity accounts for ~63% of annual total emissions (> 50% threshold).

GENSET_RELIANCE.explanation: Diesel generation produced equivalent energy exceeding 20% of total factory electricity in August.

INTENSITY_ABOVE_PEERS.explanation: August emissions of 142,897 kg CO2e over 95,000 pieces yields 1.504 kg CO2e/piece, exceeding peer P90 (0.68 kg CO2e/piece).

TARGET_DRIFT.explanation: August surge causes year-to-date cumulative emissions to exceed baseline decarbonization target trajectory.

REPORT_NOT_READY.explanation: December has a missing expected diesel document and unconfirmed draft status.

FACTOR_OUTDATED.scenario: Test harness evaluates 2024 period using a factor set dated 2022.
FACTOR_OUTDATED.explanation: Factor set age exceeds 1 year relative to reporting period.

OVERRIDE_UNAPPROVED.scenario: Unapproved custom factor override entry seeded without approver.
OVERRIDE_UNAPPROVED.explanation: Custom factor override lacks required compliance authorization.

POWER_FACTOR_PENALTY.explanation: Extracted power factor is 0.82 (< 0.90 threshold) with 42,500 BDT penalty line.
